name: Kochi Sayuri
source:
A faithful maid with a quiet demeanor and gives a plain impression, Sayuri is wholly devoted to her young mistress.

She has never been with a man until now, and needs to remind herself not to let herself become infatuated with Asato, nor let him distract her from her duties to her mistress.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_134.html#character]official site[/url]]
